subject: Regarding Your Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Assistant position at our company. We appreciate your interest in joining our team. Our hiring team will review all applications carefully and reach out to qualified candidates for the next steps in the recruitment process. We aim to finalize the selection by the end of this month. If you have any questions in the meantime, feel free to reach out to us. Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
